title: Investors to keep a track of West Asia war, crude oil prices in holiday-shortened week: Analysts - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: The ongoing war in West Asia and its impact on crude oil prices, along with the rupee-dollar trend and foreign investor activity, are expected to drive domestic equities. Key data releases on industrial production and manufacturing PMI will also influence market sentiment.
sentiment_reason: The market is influenced by negative factors such as the war's impact on crude oil prices and the outflow of foreign investments due to geopolitical tensions and currency weakness.
